The campaign has ended, and I've sent the recap below. Both ad groups ran through 11:59 PM ET on Saturday, Nov 28, and their end dates have passed, so nothing is still serving.

## Fernwick BFCM 2026 recap

| | Spend | Impressions | Link clicks |
|---|---|---|---|
| Software Dev interest | $229.99 | 115,978 | 105 |
| Gaming interest | $231.24 | 176,468 | 128 |
| **Total** | **$461.23** | **292,446** | **233** |

- **Budget:** $461.23 of the $500 was spent, so $38.77 is left over. Each ad group had a $30/day cap and a $240 total cap, so delivery came in under the full amount.
- **Cost per click:** about $1.98 overall. The Gaming interest group was slightly cheaper at about $1.81 per click, against about $2.19 for Software Dev.
- **Sign-ups:** I can't report these. X has no pixel on your site, so it can't see sign-ups. Please check your own sign-up data for traffic from fernwick.io/blackfriday during Nov 21–28.

**Setup**
- **Campaign:** one link-click campaign with two ad groups.
- **Targeting:** both ad groups targeted the US and Canada only, one by the "Technology / Software Development" interest and the other by the "Gaming" interest.
- **Posts:** I used only your four approved posts, in both ad groups, and wrote nothing new.
- **Changes during the week:** I checked delivery on Nov 22, 24 and 27 and made no changes. Spend was on pace and both ad groups were performing within a similar range.

I didn't compare the four posts individually in the final numbers. I can pull per-post results if you want them for your next campaign.
